SELECT rs.store_id ret_store, os.store_id orig_store, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund, min(f.sale_date) first_sale, max(f.sale_date) last_sale
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_store os ON os.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND rs.store_id<>os.store_id GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 40

SELECT rs.store_id ret_store, os.store_id orig_store_group, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_store os ON os.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND (rs.store_id>=900 OR os.store_id>=900) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH p AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2
),
cur AS (
  SELECT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900
),
r AS (
  SELECT d.store_id, sum(d.net_sales) AS net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales d, p
  WHERE d.business_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date AND d.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY d.store_id
)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY r.net_sales DESC) AS rank, p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_period, c.store_id, c.store_name, r.net_sales
FROM r JOIN cur c ON c.store_id = r.store_id, p
ORDER BY r.net_sales DESC
